name: coremap
description: THE USER POOL'S PAGE MAP STAYS WELL FORMED UNDER CHURN.  The pool is a 2.11BSD resource map (src/kernel/bank.s, usr/sys/sys/subr_rmap.c) of free pieces {size, address} in 256-byte pages, address = bank << 8 | page.  After textchurn's spawn/exit/fork/exec paths and fifty failed execs of a truncated image (exectrunc's fixture), coremap_check.py reads the map and requires it sorted, coalesced, inside the pool and non-empty (tools/coremap_model.py check()), and prints the free total, which each step's commit records: a page lost per failed exec would cost fifty.  Each failed exec claimed a text entry before its load and gave it up; coremap_check also reads the text table (src/kernel/tty/text.s, 36-byte entries) and refuses an entry with a key and no banks: a claim never filled and never freed, which a later exec of the same file would take for a loaded text.
